# John Teston

Software engineer portfolio: enterprise systems, developer tooling, and games.

Links here are relative to this file, which sits at the site root.

## Sections

- [Projects](/#projects): Settlement Replatform, Internal Tooling CLI, Cargo Tracking Dashboard, Warden, Tidal.
- [Skills](/#skills): Languages, frameworks, infrastructure, and game engines.
- [Education](/#education): Computer science, game development certificate, self-directed study.
- [Experience](/#experience): Four roles across logistics, health, analytics, and interactive agencies.
- [Contact](/#contact): Email and GitHub.

## Notes

Content is static and lives in `src/data/profile.ts`. There is no backend, no
tracking, and no third-party origin on the critical path except the Simple
Icons CDN used for skill glyphs.
